description: Defines data structures and function prototypes for handling Git refspecs, including parsing, matching, and applying refspecs in version control operations.

methods.name: refspec_item_init_fetch
methods.description: Initializes a refspec_item for fetch operation with a given refspec string.

methods.name: refspec_item_init_push
methods.description: Initializes a refspec_item for push operation with a given refspec string.

methods.name: refspec_item_clear
methods.description: Clears the contents of a refspec_item.

methods.name: refspec_init_fetch
methods.description: Initializes a refspec for fetch operation.

methods.name: refspec_init_push
methods.description: Initializes a refspec for push operation.

methods.name: refspec_append
methods.description: Appends a refspec string to a refspec object.

methods.name: refspec_appendf
methods.description: Appends a formatted refspec string to a refspec object.

methods.name: refspec_appendn
methods.description: Appends multiple refspec strings to a refspec object.

methods.name: refspec_clear
methods.description: Clears all refspec items from a refspec object.

methods.name: valid_fetch_refspec
methods.description: Validates if a refspec string is suitable for fetching.

methods.name: refspec_ref_prefixes
methods.description: Determines prefix values to pass to the peer in ref-prefix lines.

methods.name: refname_matches_negative_refspec_item
methods.description: Checks if a refname matches any negative refspec in the list.

methods.name: match_refname_with_pattern
methods.description: Checks if a refname matches a pattern and computes the mapped refname if applicable.

methods.name: refspec_find_match
methods.description: Finds a match for a query refspec item within a refspec.

methods.name: refspec_find_all_matches
methods.description: Finds all matches for a query refspec item and appends to results.

methods.name: apply_negative_refspecs
methods.description: Removes entries matching negative refspecs from a ref list.

methods.name: apply_refspecs
methods.description: Finds the destination refname for a given refname based on refspecs.
